inlines.v: EM'BERS, noun plural Small coals of fire with ashes; the residuum of wood, coal or other combustibles not extinguished; cinders. He rakes hot embers and renews the fires. It is used by Colebrooke in the singular. He takes a lighted ember out of the covered vessel.
